description: Header file defining the template class QuicIntervalDeque, a container for managing items with associated intervals, optimized for sequential access and binary search within the QUIC protocol implementation.

classes.name: quic::QuicIntervalDeque
classes.description: A templated container class that manages items with associated intervals, supporting efficient sequential and binary search operations.

classes.name: quic::QuicIntervalDeque::Iterator
classes.description: An iterator class for traversing the QuicIntervalDeque, supporting forward iteration and random access.

methods.name: PushBack
methods.description: Adds an item to the end of the deque, with interval validation.

methods.name: PopFront
methods.description: Removes the front item from the deque.

methods.name: DataBegin
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the beginning of the deque.

methods.name: DataEnd
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the end of the deque.

methods.name: DataAt
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the item containing the specified interval start.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the deque.

methods.name: Empty
methods.description: Checks if the deque is empty.
